about: A 21.5-minute synthetic film (text-to-speech dialogue over a noise bed). speech is what ffsubsync 0.5.1 detected in its audio; truth holds the spoken interval of every line. late = truth + 2.37 s; pal = made for a 25 fps release (t * 23.976 / 25 + 1.1 s); cut = the subtitle lacks a 40 s scene after line 33 (offsets -1.5 s, then -41.5 s). Cues are matched by id.

Where did you put the keys?
That is not what I meant and you know it.
Listen to me very carefully.
We do not have much time left.
Did you hear that noise outside?
I have never seen anything like this before.
You should call him before it gets too late.
Nobody was supposed to be here tonight.
Tell me exactly what happened.
She said she would meet us at the station.
I do not think that is a good idea.
Everything changed after that night.
Can you give me a minute, please?
They found the car near the river.
It was the best decision I ever made.
Why are you looking at me like that?

I promise I will explain everything tomorrow.
